Trading 1 B for 1 A would give me 2 A, 1 C, 0 B — reducing variety since I'd lose my only B and double up on A. Given I value variety, this trade decreases my utility. I'll decline and seek a trade that improves diversity instead.

This trade would leave me with A:3, C:1, B:0, which is highly imbalanced and eliminates my only B good entirely. Since I value variety, dropping to zero of one good is worse than my current balanced 1-1-1 holding, even though I'd gain 2 A. Better to negotiate a trade that keeps some balance, like 1 A for 1 B instead of losing my only B for 2 A."
